requirements.quote: R16: Strategy-bearing descriptions are hidden from clerks via column-scoped views.

deliverables.change: ADD COLUMN strategy; create security_barrier view obligation_clerk_v returning all columns with description NULLed when strategy; REVOKE ALL on obligation FROM causedeck_clerk; REVOKE ALL on the view FROM PUBLIC, causedeck_app, causedeck_clerk, then GRANT SELECT to causedeck_app, causedeck_clerk (as in 20261026074215_memory.sql:146-152). Include the generated meta snapshot and a _journal.json entry.
For clerk members, read obligation rows through obligation_clerk_v under a clerk-role scope; members keep the base table.
Same clerk routing for the queue view and any other obligation reads in this file.
Shared helper to open the clerk-role read scope and map view rows to ObligationRow. Writes stay on the normal role.
Allow setting `strategy`, only for owner/advocate (existing can() actions); clerks and others get FORBIDDEN. The implementer decides whether create.ts also needs it.
Add an optional boolean `strategy` to the update (and, if needed, create) input.
New test modelled on clerk-view.test.ts: the clerk role cannot read `obligation` (42501) but reads the view; a strategy row's description is NULL and others are intact; the view is tenant-isolated.
Add cases: clerk queue/view hides the strategy description and shows non-strategy ones; owner/advocate can set the flag; clerk/junior cannot; clerk task writes still work.
Add a case for the strategy update and clerk read across tenants if a new path is exposed.
Document the strategy flag and clerk view; remove the 'not delivered' consequence at :43 and the revisit trigger at :48.

preserve.what: Clerk obligation writes (tasks, defects, certified copies via obligation.track) in packages/core/src/obligations/context.ts:181-184 must keep working; do not run write paths under dbRole 'clerk'.
Owner/advocate/junior/viewer read paths and the ObligationRow shape returned by queryQueue/queryQueueView must not change for non-clerks.
app_clerk_view() in packages/db/migrations/0022_matter_restriction.sql and memory_item_clerk_v are untouched.
Existing cross-tenant obligation tests (packages/core/src/__tests__/cross-tenant/obligations.test.ts) keep passing.

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/__tests__/rls/obligation-clerk-view.test.ts src/__tests__/rls/clerk-view.test.ts src/index.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}

decisions.choice: Hand-written view with CASE on description (as in the memory view), not app_clerk_view().
decisions.justification: app_clerk_view excludes whole columns for every row (migrations/0022_matter_restriction.sql:87-128), which would hide ordinary task descriptions from clerks. Precedent: migrations/20261026074215_memory.sql:146-152 and docs/adr/0044-memory-scopes-and-confirmation.md:31.

decisions.choice: Name the migration with a timestamp tag, not 0022.
decisions.justification: 0022 is taken by matter_restriction and the journal has used timestamp tags since (packages/db/migrations/meta/_journal.json, last idx 141). The triage comment is stale.

decisions.choice: Only obligation reads in packages/core/src/obligations are routed through the view; other modules that read obligation.description are listed as follow-ups.
decisions.justification: Matches the triage plan scope. Revoking clerk privileges on the base table makes any other clerk-role read of obligation fail, so those modules must not be switched blindly.
